gloss: session; term (of a legislature or conference)

definitions.gloss: session; term; period of a meeting
definitions.explanation: The set period during which a legislative body, assembly, conference, or exhibition is in session. Defines when business can be conducted.

examples.japanese: {会期|かいき}が{延長|えんちょう}された。
{国会|こっかい}の{会期|かいき}は{来月|らいげつ}までだ。
examples.english: The Diet's session runs until next month.

examples.japanese: {法案|ほうあん}は{会期|かいき}{中|ちゅう}に{成立|せいりつ}せず、{廃案|はいあん}となった。
examples.english: The bill did not pass during the session and was scrapped.

notes:
Composed of {会|かい} (assembly, meeting) + {期|き} (period). Most often used of the Diet, local assemblies, and conferences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会期|かいき}{中|ちゅう}: during the session
- {会期|かいき}を{延長|えんちょう}する: to extend the session
- {会期|かいき}{末|まつ}: the end of the session

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {任期|にんき}: term of office — the period a person holds a position, not a meeting
- {期間|きかん}: period — the general word for any span of time
